Town, shops & places

clothes shop noun

Traupman 173

taberna vestiāria

Examples

  • Inde per viam tabernīs vestiāriīs et cuppēdināriīs plēnam ad portam urbis antīquam vēnērunt

    From there they went along a street full of clothes shops and cake shops to the old city gateLibellus III, Apud avum et aviam
